newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Q1 '97 trade gap widens to $412 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Q1 '97 trade gap widens to $412 mln.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade balance in the first three months of this year widened by 20.1 percent to $412 million from $343 million in the same 1996 period, the Central Bank said on Monday. Exports rose 10.8 percent to $1,005 million during January-March this year from $907 million in the same period in 1996, it said in a statement.

Imports rose 13.3 percent to $1,417 million from $1,251 million over the same period, the Central Bank said. Industrial exports in the same period rose 12.7 percent to $736 million from $653 million, propelled by a 13.3 percent rise in textile and apparel exports which account for 66 percent of industrial exports, it said.
